The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **The Girl You Lost**, priced at **£12.29**.

I checked both pages of the category, and page 2 is the last one. Five books are rated five stars:

| Title | Price |
|---|---|
| The Girl You Lost | £12.29 |
| The Silkworm (Cormoran Strike #2) | £23.05 |
| What Happened on Beale Street (Secrets of the South Mysteries #2) | £25.37 |
| A Time of Torment (Charlie Parker #14) | £48.35 |
| The Bachelor Girl's Guide to Murder (Herringford and Watts Mysteries #1) | £52.30 |

I worked in my own tab (t1), which is still open on page 2 of the category. Other agents' tabs appeared in the same browser session (httpbin and Swag Labs), and I didn't touch them. Partway through, the browser's active tab was one of theirs, and I switched back to my own before running anything further.

The order is complete. The confirmation page says "Thank you for your order!" and "Your order has been dispatched, and will arrive just as fast as the pony can get there!"

- **Sorting:** I set the products to price low to high.
- **Cart:** I added the Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and the Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99).
- **Checkout:** I checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001. The item total was $39.98, tax $3.20, and the total $43.18.

My first tab was replaced by another agent's page. I opened my own tab (t3) and did everything there. I left the other tabs alone. The checkout-complete page is still open in t3.
